title: DollyOS Crew
description: Generic schema for an Aura-orchestrated swarm. Synthesises CrewAI (role/goal/backstory + tasks), OpenAI Swarm (handoffs + context_variables), Anthropic orchestrator-worker (lead spawns parallel subagents with objective / output / tools / boundaries) and LangGraph (explicit process graph). Agents are browser-side clawRuntime instances — tools are MCP calls routed through the existing `mcp_call` handler. Per-user isolation is enforced via `tenant_id` lineage.

tenant_id.description: Per-user Aura instance id. Required at runtime; templates may leave blank for lineage-lock to fill in.

lineage.description: Lineage lock — which Aura template this crew belongs to, so instances can't cross-contaminate.

process.description: Orchestration mode. sequential = CrewAI sequential. parallel = Anthropic-style fan-out. hierarchical = CrewAI manager-led. graph = LangGraph-style explicit nodes/edges. swarm = OpenAI Swarm-style dynamic handoffs.

lead_agent.description: Agent id acting as orchestrator/manager. Required for hierarchical and parallel. Ignored for sequential.

shared_memory.description: Shared scratchpad available to every agent. Keys namespaced to avoid collision.

context_variables.description: Key/value state passed to every agent and mutated via handoffs (Swarm-style Result.context_variables).

handoffs.description: Dynamic transitions. Used in swarm/graph mode. Pre-declaring the legal handoff graph lets the runtime validate before executing.

edges.description: Graph-mode only. Typed edges between tasks.

guards.description: Runtime guardrails for the crew as a whole.

require_human_approval_on.description: Task ids that must not auto-execute without a human ack.

role.description: Short title — the job this agent does. Shapes reasoning. (CrewAI semantic.)

goal.description: One-line OKR. What 'done' looks like for this agent.

backstory.description: Why this agent reasons the way it does. Injected into the system prompt verbatim.

tools.description: Tools this agent may call. Each entry names an MCP server + tool, or a built-in claw handler tool.

allow_delegation.description: May this agent call into other agents as sub-tools? (CrewAI allow_delegation.)

delegate_to.description: Whitelist of agent ids this agent may hand off to. Empty = cannot delegate. Overrides allow_delegation.

memory.description: Per-agent memory config. Separate from shared_memory.

effort_budget.description: Anthropic orchestrator-worker guidance — embed scaling rules in the prompt.

output_format.description: Anthropic principle: tell the subagent its output shape. Free-form string — markdown, JSON schema, or a pointer to a schema id.

task_boundaries.description: Anthropic principle: what this agent must NOT do. Prevents scope creep.

system_prompt_suffix.description: Extra instructions appended after role/goal/backstory. Used for persona fine-tuning.

name.description: Built-in claw tool name — read_file, write_file, edit_file, glob_search, grep_search, bash, web_search, see_me, hear_me, body_state, speak_text, comfyui_generate, blender_script, todo_write.

server.description: MCP server name (e.g. crew, mind_palace, blender, comfy, lore).

agent_id.description: Invoke another agent as a tool. Only legal if listed in delegate_to.

description.description: Prose instruction handed to the agent. Supports {context.foo} interpolation.

assigned_agent.description: Agent id responsible. In hierarchical mode this may be 'auto' — lead routes at runtime.

depends_on.description: Task ids whose outputs feed this task's context (CrewAI `context`).

expected_output.description: Success criterion. The lead/manager validates outputs against this before accepting.

output_path.description: Filesystem path where the task result is persisted. Relative to crew run root. Mirrors CrewAI `output_file`.

output_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema the output must validate against.

async_execution.description: If true, does not block downstream tasks that don't depend on it.

human_in_the_loop.description: Pause after completion for human approval.

condition.description: Natural-language or JSON-logic expression evaluated against context_variables.

context_passed.description: Keys from context_variables that should be visible to the receiver. Empty = pass all.

reason_template.description: Narration string written to shared_memory when this handoff fires. Traceability.

transform.description: Optional reference to a transform fn id — reshape output before feeding the next task.
